Flow.description: DIR-1258: Called once at Modification submission (first step of the Modification orchestration's PDC stage). The RES_Pending_*/RES_Approved_* staging itself now happens at record-save time (RES_Payment_Plan_Before_Save_Edit_Lock), not here - by the time this runs, the real tracked fields already sit at the RES_Approved_* baseline and RES_Pending_* already holds the edit. This step just finalizes the "submitted" banner text (swapping the pre-submit "not yet submitted" wording for "pending PDC approval, submitted by..."), deactivates the plan, and stamps who/when it was formally submitted.

formulas.description: DIR-1258: banner text once the modification has actually been submitted for approval. Reads RES_Pending_*/RES_Approved_* (not the real tracked fields, which already equal RES_Approved_* by this point since staging happens at save time). DateTime fields get a +3 hour offset before TEXT() since Flow's TEXT() renders DateTime in GMT, not the Asia/Riyadh (UTC+3) timezone this org's users are on.
